subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR remain blocked until real embedded-agent proof demonstrates both the internal-handoff drop path and the `sessions_send` preservation path, and should it be preferred over the overlapping repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: The code change affects session-state prompt semantics, and tests/CI do not prove the contributor's real embedded-agent runtime behavior or settle the competing repair strategy.

options.title: Require runtime proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run showing stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

options.title: Accept private maintainer proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Pause behind the broader repair
options.body: Keep this branch open or close it later only after deciding that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 is the canonical landing path for the same issue.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run showing stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in PR #65478.
